grid[gain.financial].definition: A holding that rises with the environment.
grid[gain.human].definition: The activity with the highest leverage on future earning — the profession being built, the qualification being taken, the venture being started.
grid[income.financial].definition: A holding that pays a steady distribution.
grid[income.human].definition: The dependable mandate or employment that pays the bills now.
grid[protection.financial].definition: A holding that pays in crisis — it pays exactly when nothing else does, and costs you something the rest of the time.
grid[protection.human].definition: What keeps a person functioning so the other three continue: health, network, the activity not done for money.
grid[stabilisation.financial].definition: A holding that peaks in contraction — it pays before the damage, not during it.
grid[stabilisation.human].definition: Smaller, unrelated earning streams that reduce the variance of the whole.
